title: Temperature, battery, and sleep
description: Reads system state at a low frequency and explains whether an app is preventing automatic sleep.

temperature.label: Device temperature
temperature.normal: Temperature is currently within the normal range.
temperature.attention: The device is warm. If it also feels slow, reduce heavy tasks first.
temperature.urgent: Temperature is staying high. Stop heavy tasks and keep the device ventilated.
temperature.unavailable: The operating system or hardware is not exposing a temperature reading to CoreRobin.

battery.label: Battery
battery.unavailable: Desktop computers and devices without battery reporting appear this way.
battery.attention: Power is getting low; prepare to connect a charger
battery.urgent: Power is very low; connect a charger soon

temperature.waiting: Waiting for the first temperature sample.
temperature.unsupported: This system or hardware does not expose a recognized temperature sensor.
temperature.unavailable: Temperature was available earlier, but this read failed. The app will keep retrying at a low frequency.

battery.waiting: Waiting for the first battery sample.
battery.unsupported: No battery was detected. This is normal on desktop computers and similar devices.
battery.unavailable: A battery was detected, but this status read failed. The app will keep retrying.

batteryDetails.waiting: Reading battery health and cycle count.
batteryDetails.unsupported: This device does not provide battery details.
batteryDetails.unavailable: Charge level is available, but the system is not currently providing health or cycle count.

sleep.label: Automatic sleep
sleep.unavailable: This platform is not exposing reliable sleep-blocker information to CoreRobin.
sleep.clear: No app is preventing the computer from sleeping automatically.
sleep.blocked: {{name}} has prevented automatic sleep for {{duration}}{{more}}. Quitting the app or pausing its task will usually restore sleep.
sleep.system: A system task is temporarily keeping the computer awake. It usually needs no action, and system processes should not be quit.
